queries.exists: SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Microsoft Teams' AND publisher = 'Microsoft') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM system_info WHERE cpu_type LIKE 'ARM%');
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Microsoft Teams' AND publisher = 'Microsoft' AND version_compare(version, '26225.1806.5074.1452') < 0)) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM system_info WHERE cpu_type LIKE 'ARM%');
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) IN ('teams.exe','ms-teams.exe'));
